#### Bug description

The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true. This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.

agent.summary: Reproduction showed most analyzer diagnostics (MsgPack004/007/015 and the checks before the suppress return) are already reported when SuppressSourceGeneration=true. The one lost diagnostic was MsgPack011 (PartialTypeRequired), skipped by an early 'return null' for suppressed types. I moved that return below the partial-type check so the diagnostic is reported while generation still yields null. Added a test covering MsgPack004 and MsgPack011 on suppressed types; it passes with the fix. I could not verify it fails without the fix (the revert command needed approval), and I did not run the generator tests.

decisions.decision: Report PartialTypeRequired (MsgPack011) for suppressed types by moving the suppress early-return after the partial-type check
decisions.why: It was the only diagnostic in GetObjectInfo found to be skipped solely because of SuppressSourceGeneration; generation still returns null
decisions.alternatives: Leave as is (cannot reproduce a broader loss); or suppress-aware filtering elsewhere

decisions.decision: Left AOT-related suppress gating (derived KeyAttribute AOTDerivedKeyAttribute, init-property AOTInitProperty) unchanged
decisions.why: Those are deliberately conditional on suppress being false; they concern source-generation compatibility, and changing them would alter behaviour not requested
